# GameExtensions

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit` · class

```csharp
public static class GameExtensions
```

Adds the toolkit to a game.

## Methods

### InitializeToolkit

```csharp
public static void InitializeToolkit(this Framework.Game game)
```

Types: [`Game`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Game.md)

Registers the toolkit's content loaders, for fonts, atlases and sound banks. Call it first in `OnInitialize` if the game uses any of them: nothing does it for you.
